description:
BLAST a DNA or protein sequence (raw or FASTA; up to 20 kb DNA or 5,000 aa) against this site's databases:
Chinese Spring RefSeq v1.0 genome, RefSeq v1.1 CDS and proteins. The program is chosen from the query and database types (blastn, or blastn-short under 50 nt;
blastx; blastp; tblastn against CDS only). databases: ids from the list this tool returns (default: DNA query ->
reference genome + all CDS sets; protein -> all protein sets). Hits give gene ID (CDS/protein) or genome position
with overlapping genes, identity, alignment length, e-value and a genome browser link. People can use the
SequenceServer page at /blast/ for the same databases.
name: blast_sequence
